sentences.en: WOMAN: So, I understand you're interested in restaurant work?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 所以，我了解到您对餐饮行业的工作感兴趣？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: 男士：是的。

sentences.en: I've got a bit of experience and can provide references.
sentences.zh: 我有一些相关经验，也可以提供推荐信。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那很好。

sentences.en: I can check all that later.
sentences.zh: 这些我稍后都可以核实。

sentences.en: Now, Milo's Restaurants have some vacancies at the moment.
sentences.zh: 目前，米洛餐厅（Milo's Restaurants）有一些职位空缺。

sentences.en: They're a really good company to work for.
sentences.zh: 这是一家非常优秀的公司，很适合工作。

sentences.en: Lots of benefits.
sentences.zh: 福利待遇也很丰厚。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh right.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的。

sentences.en: They've got a very good reputation for looking after staff.
sentences.zh: 他们在善待员工方面享有极佳的声誉。

sentences.en: For example, all employees get training - even temporary staff.
sentences.zh: 例如，所有员工都会接受培训——即便是临时员工也不例外。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh really?
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: That's quite unusual, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这还挺少见的，对吧？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Certainly is.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 的确如此。

sentences.en: MAN: And do staff get free uniforms too?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那员工也会获得免费制服吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Um ... you just need to wear a white T-shirt and black trousers, it says here.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯……这里写的是，您只需穿一件白色T恤和黑色长裤。

sentences.en: So I guess not ...
sentences.zh: 所以我想应该不会提供……

sentences.en: But another benefit of working for a big company like this is that you can get a discount at any of their restaurants.
sentences.zh: 但像这样一家大公司的另一项福利是，您可在他们旗下的任何一家餐厅享受折扣。

sentences.en: MAN: Even at weekends?
sentences.zh: MAN: 连周末也适用吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: No, but you'll be working then anyway.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不行，不过您那时本来就在上班。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh yes.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，对。

sentences.en: I suppose so.
sentences.zh: 我想也是。

sentences.en: Most of their restaurants are in the city centre, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 他们大多数餐厅都在市中心，对吧？

sentences.en: So, easy to get to by bus?
sentences.zh: 所以乘公交车很容易到达？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But if you have to do a late shift a and finish work after midnight.
sentences.zh: 但如果您需要上晚班，并在午夜之后才下班，

sentences.en: the company will pay for you to get a taxi home.
sentences.zh: 公司会为您报销回家的出租车费用。

sentences.en: MAN: I probably won't need one.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我可能用不着。

sentences.en: I think I'd use my bike.
sentences.zh: 我想我会骑自行车回去。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Now, they do have some quite specific requirements for the kind of person they're looking for.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们对所招聘人员还有一些相当具体的要求。

sentences.en: Milo's is a young, dynamic company and they're really keen on creating a strong team.
sentences.zh: 米洛公司是一家年轻而富有活力的企业，非常重视打造一支强有力的团队。

sentences.en: It's really important that you can fit in and get on well with everyone.
sentences.zh: 您能否融入集体、与所有人融洽相处，这一点至关重要。

sentences.en: MAN: Yeah.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是啊。

sentences.en: I've got no problem with that.
sentences.zh: 这方面我完全没问题。

sentences.en: It sounds good, actually.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实不错。

sentences.en: The last place I worked for was quite demanding too.
sentences.zh: 我上一家工作单位要求也很高。

sentences.en: We had to make sure we gave a really high level of service.
sentences.zh: 我们必须确保提供极高水准的服务。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's good to hear because that will be equally important at Milo's.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听到这个消息很好，因为这在米洛餐厅也同样重要。

sentences.en: I know they want people who have an eye for detail.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们想找那些注重细节的人。

sentences.en: MAN: That's fine.
sentences.zh: MAN: 没问题。

sentences.en: I'm very used to working in that kind of environment.
sentences.zh: 我对在这种环境中工作已经非常习惯了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Perfect.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 完美。

sentences.en: So the only other thing that's required is good communication skills, so you'll need to have a certificate in English.
sentences.zh: 所以唯一其他要求就是良好的沟通能力，因此你需要持有英语证书。

sentences.en: MAN: Sure.
sentences.zh: MAN: 当然可以。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's have a look at the current job vacancies at Milo's.
sentences.zh: 我们来看看米洛餐厅目前的职位空缺。

sentences.en: The first one is in Wivenhoe Street.
sentences.zh: 第一个职位在维文霍街。

sentences.en: MAN: Sorry, where?
sentences.zh: MAN: 抱歉，您说的是哪里？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Wivenhoe.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 维文霍（Wivenhoe）。

sentences.en: W-I-V-E-N-H-O-E.
sentences.zh: 拼写是 W-I-V-E-N-H-O-E。

sentences.en: It's quite central, just off Cork Street.
sentences.zh: 位置相当中心，就在科克街旁边。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh right.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: They're looking for a breakfast supervisor.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 他们正在招聘早餐主管。

sentences.en: MAN: That would be OK.
sentences.zh: MAN: 这个职位我可以接受。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So you're probably familiar with the kind of responsibilities involved.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 所以你可能对这类职责比较熟悉。

sentences.en: Obviously checking that all the portions are correct, etc., and then things like checking all the procedures for cleaning the equipment are being followed.
sentences.zh: 显然包括检查所有餐份是否准确等，以及检查设备清洁流程是否得到遵守等事项。

sentences.en: MAN: OK.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And what about the salary?
sentences.zh: 那么薪资待遇如何？

sentences.en: In my last job was getting £9.50 per hour.
sentences.zh: 我上一份工作时每小时工资是9.50英镑。

sentences.en: I was a hoping to get a bit more than that.
sentences.zh: 我希望这次能略高一些。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, to begin with, you'd be getting £9.75 but that goes up to £11.25 after three months.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，起薪是每小时9.75英镑，三个月后将涨至11.25英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: That's not too bad.
sentences.zh: MAN: 这还不算太差。

sentences.en: And I suppose it's a very early start?
sentences.zh: 我想这份工作应该需要很早开始上班吧？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Mmm.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: That's the only unattractive thing about this job.
sentences.zh: 这也是这份工作的唯一缺点。

sentences.en: But then you have the afternoons and evenings free.
sentences.zh: 但之后你的下午和晚上都是自由的。

sentences.en: So the restaurant starts serving breakfast from 7 a.m.
sentences.zh: 餐厅从早上7点开始供应早餐。

sentences.en: And you'd have to be there at 5.30 to set everything up.
sentences.zh: 而你必须在凌晨5:30就到岗，准备一切事宜。

sentences.en: But you'd be finished at 12.30.
sentences.zh: 不过你12:30就能下班了。

sentences.en: MAN: Mmm.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, as you say, there are advantages to that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如您所说，这确实也有其优势。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Now, you might also be interested in the job at the City Road branch.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 接下来，您或许也会对城市路分店的职位感兴趣。

sentences.en: That's for a junior chef, so again a position of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 该职位是初级厨师，同样是一个负有责任的岗位。

sentences.en: MAN: I might prefer that, actually.
sentences.zh: MAN: 实际上，我可能更倾向于这个职位。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right, well obviously this role would involve supporting the sous chef and other senior staff.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，那么显然这一职位需要协助副主厨及其他资深员工。

sentences.en: And you'd be responsible for making sure there's enough stock each week - and sorting out all the deliveries.
sentences.zh: 同时，你还要负责确保每周库存充足，并处理所有货物配送事宜。

sentences.en: MAN: I've never done that before, but I imagine it's fairly straightforward, once you get the hang of it.
sentences.zh: 男士：我以前从未做过那件事，但我想象一下，一旦你掌握了要领，应该相当简单。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, and you'd be working alongside more experienced staff to begin with, so I'm sure it wouldn't be a problem.
sentences.zh: 女士：是的，而且一开始你会和更有经验的员工一起工作，所以我相信这不会是个问题。

sentences.en: The salary's slightly higher here.
sentences.zh: 薪水在这里略高一些。

sentences.en: It's an annual salary of £23,000.
sentences.zh: 年薪为23,000英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: Right.
sentences.zh: 男士：好的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I know that if they like if you, it's likely you'll be promoted quite quickly.
sentences.zh: 女士：我知道，如果他们喜欢你，你很可能很快就会获得晋升。

sentences.en: So that's worth thinking about.
sentences.zh: 所以这一点值得考虑。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: 男士：是的。

sentences.en: It does sound interesting.
sentences.zh: 这听起来确实很有趣。

sentences.en: What are the hours like?
sentences.zh: 工作时间是怎样的？

sentences.en: WOMAN: The usual, I think.
sentences.zh: 女士：我想是常规的工作时间。

sentences.en: There's a lot of evening and weekend work, but they're closed on Mondays.
sentences.zh: 有很多晚间和周末的工作，但他们每周一休息。

sentences.en: But you do get one Sunday off every four weeks.
sentences.zh: 不过你每四周会有一个周日可以休息。

sentences.en: So would you like me to send off your
sentences.zh: 那么，您希望我帮您寄出……
